UNBOUND, DEFINED: gcd or lcm is unbound when any argument is not a sympy Number. An argument that is iterable (sympy's own test, hasattr __iter__) is read element by element, so a tuple, Tuple and FiniteSet are all covered. Every positional argument counts, so a generator written in the claim makes the call unbound, and a keyword argument changes nothing. The reason says what the value would rest on and what would bind it, in words a reader can act on.
